plain: Worship of images or things as gods.

webster.text: The worship of idols, images, or any thing made by hands, or which is not God.

more.text: Excessive attachment or veneration for any thing, or that which borders on adoration.

example.quote: Idolatry is the parent of errors in politics as well as religion;&3151;and an implicit confidence in our rulers now, will be abused as much as implicit confidence in priests ever was in the days of superstition.
example.cite: An Old Whig VIII, Philadelphia Independent Gazetteer, Feb. 6, 1788
